body:
# Everload

A synchronization mod that allows modpacks creator to perform hot changes to kubejs assets/scripts and various configs without having to update the client.

# 📃 Privacy & Data Disclaimer

This mod downloads required data files from a configurable public repository on startup (hosted on services such as [GitHub](https://github.com/)).

The mod itself **does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data** about users.

However, when connecting to download content, your device may automatically share certain technical information (such as your IP adress) with the hosting service as part of normal internet communication. This data is processed solely by the hosting provider in accordance with their privacy policy.  
For mor information, please refer to the privacy policy of the hosting service.

By using this mod, you acknowledge that external resources are loaded from third-party services.
